units.text: Each of these tests has a case-sensitive version and a case-insensitive version, whose name begins with ‘⟦0⟧’. In a case-insensitive comparison, the patterns ‘⟦1⟧’ and ‘⟦2⟧’ match the file names ⟦3⟧, ‘⟦4⟧’, ‘⟦5⟧’, ‘⟦6⟧’, etc.
units.sourceHTML: Each of these tests has a case-sensitive version and a case-insensitive version, whose name begins with ‘i’. In a case-insensitive comparison, the patterns ‘fo*’ and ‘F??’ match the file names Foo, ‘FOO’, ‘foo’, ‘fOo’, etc.
